children: India-made models strengthen Maruti Suzuki’s presence in Japan as the country becomes its second-largest export market
Maruti Suzuki India has crossed 1 lakh cumulative exports of the Jimny 5-door, Fronx and e Vitara to Japan.

Japan is Maruti Suzuki’s second-largest export market by volume. Exports of the Fronx to Japan started in August 2024, followed by the Jimny 5-door in December that year. The e Vitara, Maruti Suzuki’s first battery electric vehicle (BEV), joined the export line-up in September 2025.
The Jimny 5-door and e Vitara are manufactured exclusively in India.
Japan was Maruti Suzuki’s second-largest export market in financial year 2025-26 and has retained that position during April-August of financial year 2026-27.

The company said the three models have also contributed to Suzuki Motor Corporation becoming the largest vehicle importer in Japan in FY26. Vehicles manufactured by Maruti Suzuki accounted for nearly all of Suzuki’s vehicle imports into Japan during the year.

The company now exports vehicles to nearly 120 countries. It exported more than 1.8 lakh units between April and August of FY27 and remained India’s largest passenger vehicle exporter from FY22 to FY26, according to the company.

Maruti Suzuki said it accounts for more than 50 per cent of India’s passenger vehicle exports. The growing demand for its vehicles in Japan also gives the company a stronger role in Suzuki’s global manufacturing and export strategy.
